stem.text: Nitric oxide, NO, and bromine vapour react together according to the following equation.
The reaction has an activation energy of $+5.4\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
What is the correct reaction pathway diagram for this reaction?

A.alt: Enthalpy profile: ΔH arrow from reactant level down to product level; E_A arrow from product level up to the peak.

B.alt: Enthalpy profile: E_A arrow from reactant level up to the peak; ΔH arrow from the peak level down to product level.

C.alt: Enthalpy profile: E_A arrow from reactant level up to the peak; ΔH arrow from product level up to reactant level.

D.alt: Enthalpy profile: E_A arrow from reactant level up to the peak; ΔH arrow from reactant level down to product level.
